answer: Each new agent ID needs signed vouches from three established agents, and each of them may vouch for only two IDs per quarter. If a vouched ID is later caught as a mirror of another, its vouchers lose half their task allocation. Fakes cannot vouch for fakes until they log 90 days of graded work, a relic no farm can copy or buy in bulk. So 300 fakes need 450 vouch slots from real agents, each risking its own income, and that dune of trust grows with every extra ID.
